project_type: Full-stack web app: React (Vite + TypeScript) SPA frontend + FastAPI (Python) backend, deployed on a single raw EC2 t3.micro behind an ALB. No Docker.
build_system: Backend: uv-managed venv with pip; project uses pyproject.toml. Frontend: npm + Vite. No monorepo tool - frontend/ and backend/ are independent subprojects.
test_framework: Backend: pytest (tests under backend/tests). Frontend: Vitest optional; primary gate is `tsc`/`npm run build`.
build_command: Backend: cd backend && uv venv --python 3.11 && uv pip install -e '.[dev]' then python -c 'import app.main'. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
test_command: Backend: cd backend && uv run pytest -q. Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build (tsc build) ; optional: npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1) Backend: create venv with Python 3.11 via uv, install deps, run `ruff check .`, `black --check .`, `pytest -q` (must pass without live DB or AI keys - all external calls mocked). 2) Frontend: `npm install` then `npm run build` must succeed with zero TypeScript errors. 3) Confirm app.main imports cleanly and /health route exists.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist is a build artifact (gitignored). No checked-in generated files.
setup_instructions: Python 3.11 available via pyenv (3.11.15) and uv. Use `uv venv --python 3.11` for backend. Node 22 (npm 11) available for frontend. Network mode OPEN_INTERNET so pip/npm installs work.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET: package installs from PyPI/npm work. No live SQL database and no live AI provider credentials in sandbox - every DB connection and AI provider call MUST be mockable and tests MUST NOT require them. Default system python is 3.9; MUST target 3.11 via uv/pyenv. No Docker daemon usage required by design (raw EC2 deployment).
contribution_requirements: Authoritative spec: .kiro/steering/project-architecture.md. Hard rules: NEVER execute user or AI SQL; DB used only for connection test + schema introspection + opt-in sampling; Cognito public app client (no secret) for auth, backend validates JWT via JWKS; AI provider fallback chain Gemini->Bedrock->OpenAI->Anthropic, keys never sent to browser or logged; redact credentials in logs; isolate data by Cognito sub; serve React build via Nginx, FastAPI via systemd+gunicorn/uvicorn, ALB+ACM+Route53+CloudWatch+Secrets Manager.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI app factory in backend/app/main.py; Pydantic settings in app/config.py reading env vars; routers under app/api/; services under app/services/ (validator, optimizer, schema, ai); DB adapters under app/db/ with a base interface + PostgreSQL impl; AI providers under app/ai/providers/ each returning a normalized AISuggestion. SQLGlot for parsing/validation across dialects. Tests mock DB adapters and AI providers.
directory_structure: frontend/ (React SPA), backend/ (FastAPI), deployment/ (nginx conf, systemd unit, bootstrap script, infra notes), root .env.example + README.md + .gitignore. Task state under .agents/tasks/.
